title: GoreeCloud UI — manual assistive-technology and real-device acceptance matrix
scope: Experimental web reference lab only; does not certify any native app or consumer.
requiredEvidence: When a case is tested, attach versioned source/build SHA, device/OS/browser/AT versions, result, reproduction steps, redacted screenshot or accessible announcement record, date and reviewer.

entries.steps: Traverse tabs with VoiceOver; change selection using arrows
entries.expected: Selected tab name, selected state and associated panel are announced; focus remains predictable

entries.steps: Open and close the native drawer using keyboard and VoiceOver
entries.expected: Dialog name and modal state announced; Escape closes; focus returns to trigger

entries.steps: Open action menu; traverse options, including a disabled option
entries.expected: Menu semantics, active option, unavailable state and focus recovery are announced accurately

entries.steps: Search commands, use arrows, activate enabled choice, try disabled choice
entries.expected: Command names, search results and status changes announced; disabled choices never activate

entries.steps: Sort text and date columns ascending/descending; reset
entries.expected: Column headings, sort direction and changed row order conveyed without losing context

entries.steps: Expand, collapse and navigate nested tree items, including disabled ancestors
entries.expected: Name, hierarchy, level, expanded/selected and disabled relationships accurately conveyed

entries.steps: Search filtered options, navigate, escape, select and recover from no matches
entries.expected: Combobox name, expansion, active option, number/status and selection conveyed

entries.steps: Switch light/dark and contrast while navigating semantic controls
entries.expected: Control meaning survives palette changes; foreground and focus remain distinguishable

entries.steps: Swipe among bottom destinations, activate enabled and disabled links
entries.expected: Destination names, current location and unavailable state announced; no false navigation

entries.steps: With on-screen keyboard open, filter suggestions and activate a result
entries.expected: Suggestions remain visible and reachable; selection and feedback announced

entries.steps: Open and dismiss action menu; test touch exploration
entries.expected: Menu is reachable and can be dismissed; no trapped focus or accidental activation

entries.steps: Navigate bottom controls through rotor/swipes and reopen a route
entries.expected: Current destination updates correctly and accessible labels remain distinct

entries.steps: Open, dismiss and reopen modal drawer with touch and external keyboard
entries.expected: Modal does not obscure actionable content; focus recovery is predictable

entries.steps: Inspect 320/390 CSS widths, both themes, OS font scaling and portrait/landscape
entries.expected: No clipped actions/overlays or horizontal scroll; controls reachable with touch

entries.steps: Inspect light/dark, dynamic type, reduced motion and safe areas
entries.expected: Reading order preserved and floating controls do not obscure content

entries.steps: Render light/dark/forced-colors/reduced-motion and 200/400% real zoom
entries.expected: No occlusion or unreadable text; real keyboard and viewport behavior documented

entries.steps: Change enabled toggle selections with arrows and try aria-disabled option
entries.expected: Pressed state accurately announced; unavailable choice never activates

entries.steps: Open disclosure groups and navigate headings/summary controls
entries.expected: Expanded/collapsed status accurately announced; content is exposed when open

entries.steps: Trigger meaningful status message and dismiss it
entries.expected: Status appears once, is announced at the correct urgency and is dismissible

entries.steps: Inspect full lab at 1440x900, light/dark, contrast and keyboard focus
entries.expected: Premium hierarchy, focus visibility, contrast and functional controls verified
